+    Like other fixed-width formats, this format allows specification of
+    additional header rows (in addition to the column name row) via the
+    ``header_rows`` keyword.  This can be used to include additional
+    information such as the column unit, format, or description.  For
+    example, a table with ``name`` and ``unit`` header rows can be written
+    and read back using::
+
+        >>> from astropy.table import QTable
+        >>> import astropy.units as u
+        >>> import sys
+        >>> tbl = QTable({'wave': [350, 950] * u.nm, 'response': [0.7, 1.2] * u.count})
+        >>> tbl.write(sys.stdout, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name", "unit"])
+        ===== ========
+         wave response
+           nm       ct
+        ===== ========
+        350.0      0.7
+        950.0      1.2
+        ===== ========
+
     Currently there is no support for reading tables which utilize continuation lines,
     or for ones which define column spans through the use of an additional
     line of dashes in the header.
